summary: The portfolio workspace contains a single file, index.html (1,395 lines), using Tailwind CSS CDN and Lucide icons. The sticky top panel (<header>, lines 80-115) renders the brand indicator and 3 template switcher buttons (tab-btn-A/B/C) managed by switchTemplate() and renderCurrentTemplate() (lines 1347-1376) with default currentTemplate = 'A' (line 412). Template C ('3. 에디토리얼 미니멀') is defined in renderTemplateC() (lines 1133-1344) and relies on shared portfolioData (lines 171-410), renderHeroSection('C') (lines 506-611), modal/toast helpers (lines 416-503), and an internal Template 03 intro banner (lines 1136-1143) plus anchor nav bar (lines 1145-1156).
